item.title: Bank of England Downgrades UK Growth Forecast to Just 0.9%
item.description: Along with its interest rate decision the Bank of England has downgraded its growth projections for the UK. Unemployment resulting from tax hikes and the minimum wage hike are to blame… Growth forecasts are down this year to 0.9% from 1.2% in November and 1.5% in 2027 compared to 1.6% in November. Downgrades all round……

item.title: Chagos Bill Pulled Again as Starmer’s Surrender Deal Falters
item.description: It’s another setback for Starmer’s Chagos deal as the enabling legislation has been delayed again.
